## Linked Issue

Refs #2474

<!-- Choose exactly one primary line: Refs #1234 keeps unfinished issue work open; Closes #1234 is for the child issue fully accepted by this PR. Keep ordinary explanations and related issues as Markdown links; use Closes only when the complete issue is accepted. -->

## Scope Summary

- Exact base #4352 head `0c96259e00f9d39d41824110f63c3cc260a2cbf3`; original blob `2600ffd78a9316be7ce50868df6667291d8d85be`. One production path: `src/backend/Services/Authoring/ArticleGraphQueryService.cs`; ordinary WIP and the pre-existing required naming declaration complete the three-path draft.
- Replace untrusted filter/node/edge enumeration with captured-Count indexed snapshots: reject negative/over-limit Count, copy only that bounded count, recheck Count, wrap the private array read-only. Actual copied filters maximum68 (32 categories,32 tags,4 kinds); provider node/edge maxima remain admitted1000/2000. Original shared Validate runs on the frozen actual request before source.ReadAsync and on the frozen provider projection before Seal.
- Restore the original scalar/identity/depth/budget refusal before touching caller lists by invoking the original Validate with private fixed benign filters. This checks original rules without duplicating them. The benign filters never reach the provider, response digest or accepted actual request. Thus SchemaVersion0 is refused before a custom Count/indexer can run.
- For an indexed ArgumentOutOfRangeException or IndexOutOfRangeException, refuse only when current Count proves the failed captured index is no longer present (Count<=index). Otherwise bare throw preserves the original exception. Proof Count getters execute inside the catch body so their arbitrary failures or cancellation are not silently discarded by an exception filter. No broad catch or new OperationCanceledException catch.
- Snapshot failure short-circuits later lists and returns the original invalid-filter or source-budget refusal. Preserve original deadline/caller cancellation, default/explicit depth, stale/error mapping, Empty/Seal and null-provider Unavailable. No provider/relation/permission implementation or authority, route/DI registration, scanner, shared-contract or R24 source changes.

## Change Classification

- [x] Behavior change
- [ ] Format-only
- [ ] Naming-only
- [ ] Generated output
- [ ] Public contract change
- [x] External naming exception
- Contract impact: none

`Behavior change`, `Format-only`, and `Naming-only` are mutually exclusive. `Generated output`, `Public contract change`, and `External naming exception` are supplementary.

The gate reads fields only from their named section, rejects duplicate fields or headings hidden in fenced examples, and requires contract checkboxes to be checked. Record a not-applicable reason in `Notes For Reviewers` before checking that review item.

## Tests Run

- [ ] `./tools/test.sh fast`: HOLD/UNRUN
- [ ] Targeted backend tests: HOLD/UNRUN
- [ ] Targeted frontend checks: not selected; no frontend path changed
- [x] Other: Fresh original complete Server locked --no-incremental build on exact base and final source head: both330warnings/0errors/exit0; all660 emitted diagnostic lines and330 unique entries compared with only checkout-root normalization, delta0. Original refs/analyzers/configuration/severities retained.
- [x] Other: original strict changed-file C# checker PASS0 (files1/violations0/new0); original complete C# scan FAIL1 with byte-identical552-line baseline/candidate logs; original code-intent FAIL1 with byte-identical2 existing errors. No baseline/configuration/gate changes.
- [x] Other: full diff whitespace, commit range/title/repository and actual REST PR contract checked locally; unchanged relation port/default unavailable prefix, Empty and all shared contracts compared to exact base. Completed task-local logs and SHA256 digests in ordinary WIP.
- [ ] Runtime/tests/discovery/product/helper/parser module execution/database/frozen/qualification: HOLD/UNRUN

## UI Evidence

- [ ] Screenshots or video attached for UI changes
- [ ] Mobile layout checked
- [ ] Dark mode checked
- [ ] Accessibility and reduced-motion impact considered

## Coding Convention

- [x] C# mother-style mapping checked
- [x] Formatter/linter run
- [x] No tool default overrides repository style
- [x] Mechanical formatting separated from logic
- [x] `.git-blame-ignore-revs` updated when applicable

For a `Format-only` change, complete every field. The idempotence evidence must be one repository-relative `.json` path changed by this PR and conform to `fsusblog.format-idempotence-evidence.v1`. Use `none` for other changes.

- Formatter identity: none
- Formatter version: none
- Formatter command: none
- Formatter idempotence evidence: none
- Blame-ignore revision: none

## External Naming Exception

For a checked `External naming exception`, point to one changed repository-relative JSON manifest using `fsusblog.external-naming-exceptions.v1`. Each entry binds one registered exception ID to its own changed paths and substantive reason; the union must exactly cover every changed registered naming surface. A missing manifest already named by an authoritative merged PR may instead use `fsusblog.post-merge-external-naming-evidence-repair.v1`; that strict repair binds immutable merge history, unchanged source blob/revision identity, the registered surface, and the exact missing artifact without changing the source again. Use `none` otherwise.

- Exceptions manifest: artifacts/change-contract/issue-2474-bounded-memory-external-naming.json

## Documentation / Intent

- [x] Public API docs updated
- [x] Ownership/security/performance intent updated
- [x] Historical handoff archived or source-of-truth updated
- [x] TODO/FIXME references valid issues

## Compatibility And Risk

- [x] [Cross-language coding conventions](../docs/development/coding-conventions.md) reviewed
- [x] Document lifecycle updated: stable facts are current; issue handoffs are historical/proposed; generated docs identify their producer
- [x] External wire / ABI / database / third-party names preserved or explicitly adapted
- [x] Public API impact reviewed
- [x] AEDS frame / binary contract impact reviewed
- [x] Database migration impact reviewed
- [x] Security, auth, moderation, PoW, or privacy impact reviewed
- [x] Docs updated or a reason is recorded below
- [x] Known limitations updated if applicable

## Performance Claim

Use `none` and `Evidence path: none` unless the PR title type is `perf`. For S/M/R/C, the evidence path must be a changed repository-relative JSON manifest using `fsusblog.performance-claim-evidence.v1`; it binds the one perf commit SHA, claim level, `structural-only`/`measured` status, and each changed evidence file with its SHA-256 digest.

- Claim level: none
- Evidence path: none
- Non-goals: no measured performance, relation API integration or qualification claim

## Release Note

The matching `release-note:*` label selects the generated release category. GitHub renders the merged PR title as the release entry, so every included category requires `Summary` to exactly equal the summary portion of the PR title after `type(scope):`; `Category: none` instead requires `Summary: none`. Pure formatting, internal renames, and CI rearrangement must use `Internal/Tooling` or `none`.

- Audience: internal
- Category: Internal/Tooling
- Summary: bound article graph snapshots before validation

## Generated Output

For a checked `Generated output`, bind the output to its source through one repository-relative `.json` manifest path changed by this PR. Normal atomic source/output changes use `fsusblog.generated-output-binding.v1`. A generated-only repair for a source omission already merged into the PR base uses `fsusblog.post-merge-generated-output-repair.v1`; it must name one trusted producer and leave its source and generator unchanged. A trusted ordered multi-producer repair uses `fsusblog.post-merge-generated-output-repair-dag.v2` and its registry-owned canonical manifest path. An authenticated bot must identify itself exactly. Use `none` otherwise.

- Generator source: none
- Generated outputs: none
- Digest/evidence: none
- Automation identity: none

## Rollout / Rollback

- Rollout: same independent draft for SOURCE re-review only; no activation or publication
- Rollback: revert only this task's production-file changes if independent review rejects them; no live data changes
- Deferred work: independent review and all original runtime, tests/discovery, relation integration, database, frozen and qualification work remain HOLD/UNRUN
- Known limitations: global C#552-line failure and code-intent2-error failure remain unchanged. Arbitrary Count/indexer callbacks can still block or allocate internally; same-count races are not atomic snapshots. Only observed shrinkage/index loss is classified as refusal. No runtime equivalence, real relation API or lifecycle/qualification claim

## Notes For Reviewers

Ordinary WIP: `artifacts/article-editor/issue-2474-bounded-memory-budget.json`. The pre-existing naming manifest still declares exactly this one managed source path under the unchanged broad trusted registry. No external spelling/environment key, public wire/DTO/AEDS/ABI/database semantics, contract, policy, receipt or gate changed. Existing contract docs remain applicable. Mechanical formatting, generated outputs, blame-ignore and TODO additions are inapplicable; review checkboxes confirm review rather than fabricated edits.

The requested two P2 source repairs are implemented for re-review. Static reasoning for invalid SchemaVersion0 stops in original validation before any caller-list operation, including refusal sealing through unchanged Empty. Indexed shrinkage recognition requires both the known bounds-exception class and proof that the captured index is absent. Stable-count/unproved bounds failures, source.ReadAsync failures, Count getter failures and other provider exceptions are not converted to empty results; original cancellation handling remains the only OCE catch. No catch-all, retry or exception-derived fabricated relation facts.

The private preflight filter shape is only bounded input to the original scalar validator; it is not permission/filter admission for real facts, a source request or another authority. Actual caller filters are still bounded, frozen and completely validated before the sole source call. Invalid snapshot refusal uses bounded sanitized lists and invalid empty kinds to preserve invalid-request digest suppression.

Count rechecks and index-loss detection are ordinary bounded SOURCE controls, not linearizable concurrency, arbitrary callback memory/time safety or runtime qualification. The source owner retains permission-before-expansion/count/budget and its own expansion/index/payload work. Missing real relation API still returns honest Unavailable; the unavailable source and public relation port are byte-identical to base.

All tests/list/discovery/collection, runtime/product/helper/parser module execution, browser/native/database/frozen/qualification remain HOLD/UNRUN. No merge, Ready, closure, publication, release, authority refresh or configuration/gate relaxation. Local static checks are not remote CI or product qualification. This same draft remains an incomplete increment of open #2474; independent re-review is pending.
